data.title: 伽玛 · 祭典夜市的巡店
data.description: 夏日祭的夜市里，伽玛穿着牡丹浴衣慢慢巡视四越商会的连排摊位。灯笼的光映在她脸上，摊主们纷纷挺直腰板——会长来查账了。
data.location: summer festival night market street lined with lantern-lit stalls of a trading company
data.action: walking slowly through the night market inspecting stalls, yukata, holding a small ledger, gentle smile
data.lighting: 夜市灯笼的暖橙光与远处烟火的闪光
data.mood: festive warmth, quiet authority among the stalls
data.promptProse: In a peony yukata, Gamma strolls the festival night market, checking each Mitsugoshi stall with a smile and a ledger.
data.animaCaption: Even at a festival, Gamma counts the takings — but tonight, she lets herself enjoy the lanterns a little.
